items.title: Darwin case runner: refuse non-finite recorded durations in is_ms
items.summary:
Part of #1484

## What

The Darwin case runner's shared timing predicate `is_ms` in `interop/multipath/native_darwin.py` accepts positive infinity. Python's `json.loads` decodes `1e999` (and the literal `Infinity`) to `inf`. `is_ms` only checks `type(value) in (int, float) and value >= 0`, so a readback receipt with an infinite duration passes `check_record` and `validate_results`. items.title: guest: run agents in a wasm32-wasip2 component with host-provided LLM and MCP, plus an atomic-agent-runner component

## Problem

atomic-agents can't run inside a WebAssembly component today: it depends on tokio, reqwest (native-tls), rmcp and tiktoken, none of which build for `wasm32-wasip2`.
